data.body: Investigate a bounded remedy for the documented receiver input prerequisites. Use only read-only official release metadata, current local file signatures and the retained LUX48 inventories to determine whether existing Node24.20 headers/archive/import-library and the retained Electron44.3 distribution can be verified without reacquiring or executing them. Preserve the absence of historical acquisition receipts; a new authenticity check must not be reported as historical acquisition attribution. Draft one exact docs/implementation/receiver-input-recovery-plan.md only if evidence supports concrete next steps. Any change to b1 dependency selection needs a separate independent review of this plan and actual manifest checks. No downloads of native code/distributions, install, copy, build, package export, source changes, GPU/Studio/portal or system settings. If public verification is unavailable, retain the precise unresolved prerequisite and investigation evidence rather than weakening accepted criteria. This is root coordination/planning under the existing four-workstream grant; LUX48 source review and b1 acceptance remain separate.

events.body: Official headers checksum matches, retained node.lib differs from official24.20 x64/arm64. Electron archive digest cannot authenticate loose tree; executable unsigned. Evidence receiver-recovery-investigation.md; no justified recovery plan/input substitution.

LUX59 read-only investigation, main e4da110c17c87dede9501b4399e0333870c8a32b.
Official Node metadata was read on 2026-09-13 from https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.20.0/SHASUMS256.txt (HTTP200,3171 bytes) in receiver-recovery-node-shasums-network.txt. Retained headers.tar.gz hash 7b2141e77e66ab23ead6b200c546afc5837136e3075d8a3ac5a67e540dcc59c1 matches official node-v24.20.0-headers.tar.gz. This is current HTTPS metadata comparison, not signed checksum verification or historical acquisition attribution.
Retained node.lib independently rehashed FC08FF294C2DB5F0C9184A60BA52AA756FDADA5B458108B6EDA2308A3DA5E48F. Official win-x64/node.lib is63ec831bbf164d1b23197d6fac1944dfb146534e332889ca0755d250e8dedff9, arm64 is88dea6ff6656445ee22ed8843816d8d90d707c3d05228bd0a3ad56ea30e8a395. Neither matches. Do not use the retained import library as an authenticated official Node24.20 input; mismatch alone does not establish maliciousness or explain origin.
Official Electron release metadata https://api.github.com/repos/electron/electron/releases/tags/v44.3.0 HTTP200,132721 bytes supplies electron-v44.3.0-win32-x64.zip size158149320 SHA26bf9a617d58d81772b3d68305d59ee48272969c15083c06db634a77358a8d9d. This archive digest does not authenticate a loose extracted file tree without the matching original archive and verified member comparison. Retained electron.exe reports NotSigned; no signer/timestamp. No original archive established within this bounded investigation. Main runtime remains absent per LUX48; candidate not selected.
Normal sandbox metadata requests failed TLS; preserved receiver-recovery-fetch-results.json. Scoped escalated metadata-only reads succeeded with no certificate bypass, retained receiver-recovery-network-results.json. Browser Node fetch failed nonretryable; GitHub release page loaded but asset hashes absent in browser view. No code/distribution acquired or executed, no installation/copy/build/export/portal/GPU/system settings. No recovery plan drafted because current evidence cannot support satisfying original prerequisites. LUX59 blocked for authenticated import-library and Electron archive/member provenance; LUX48 report review separate. Any future acquisition or input-selection change requires a separately scoped authorization/plan; LUX7 policy stop preserved.
Read-only remedy investigation preserves original prerequisites and requires later independent plan review before changing input selection.
